title: Verify every slide View Project link has a valid href that returns a successful response
preconditions: Home page (/) is loaded on the target environment at desktop viewport 1280x800; user is not logged in
Featured Projects section is scrolled into view
steps: For each slide read the label and the href of its a.more-link link
Request each href (HTTP GET) and read the response status
expected_result: Every link is labelled "View Project", has a non-empty href that points to a project page (path contains "/project/"), and its URL responds with HTTP 200 (no 404 or other error).

title: Verify clicking View Project opens the matching project page for every slide
preconditions: Home page (/) is loaded on the target environment at desktop viewport 1280x800; user is not logged in
Featured Projects section is scrolled into view
Carousel is on the first slide

test_data.title_comparison: h1 text equals slide h4 title, ignoring case and surrounding whitespace

steps: Note the title and the href of the slide currently first in view
Read the page URL and the h1 text of the opened page
Navigate back to the home page, scroll to the Featured Projects section, and click Next as many times as needed to bring the next slide into view
Repeat steps 1-4 for each remaining slide
expected_result: For each slide the opened page URL matches the slide link href, the page loads without an error, and its h1 text matches the slide title.

title: Verify clicking a slide image does not navigate
preconditions: Home page (/) is loaded on the target environment at desktop viewport 1280x800; user is not logged in
Featured Projects section is scrolled into view
Carousel is on the first slide
steps: Click the first slide image once without moving the pointer
Wait about 1 second for the slide animation to finish
expected_result: The page stays on the home page: the URL is unchanged and no project page opens.

title: Verify clicking a slide title does not navigate
preconditions: Home page (/) is loaded on the target environment at desktop viewport 1280x800; user is not logged in
Featured Projects section is scrolled into view
Carousel is on the first slide
steps: Click the first slide title (h4) once
Wait about 1 second for the slide animation to finish
expected_result: The page stays on the home page: the URL is unchanged and no project page opens.

title: Verify returning to the home page with browser Back resets the carousel to the first slide
preconditions: Home page (/) is loaded on the target environment at desktop viewport 1280x800; user is not logged in
Featured Projects section is scrolled into view
Carousel is on the first slide
steps: Click Next twice, waiting for the animation after each click, and read the translate3d X offset
Click the "View Project" link of the first slide in view
Wait for the project page to load, then use the browser Back button
Scroll to the Featured Projects section and read the translate3d X offset and the first visible slide title
expected_result: The home page is shown again and the carousel is back at its start position: the first slide (item--0) is the first visible slide and the offset equals the initial value.
